  // Clock and training hooks only run after ordinary move legality has been checked.
  function beforeMove(i,origin){if(experienceBeforeMove&&!experienceBeforeMove(i,origin))return false;
    if(repertoireMove(i,origin))return false;
    if(network&&origin!=='remote'){if(networkOpeningMove(i))return false;if(network.role==='spectator'||network.color!==currentColor()){toast('Wait for your turn in the room.');return false;}sendRoom({action:'move',i});return false;}
    if(training&&training.step<training.sequence.length){if(origin!=='training'&&currentColor()!==training.color){toast('Wait for the recorded defensive reply.');return false;}const expected=training.sequence[training.step];if(i!==expected){training.misses++;$('proofTrainingText').textContent='Not the stored continuation. This drill follows one verified line; other winning moves may exist.';return false;}}
    if(clock.enabled&&!S.result){tickClock();if(S.result)return false;if(!clock.running){if(S.records.length){toast('Clock paused. Resume before playing.');return false;}clock.side=currentColor();clock=C.clockAction(clock,'resume',Date.now());scheduleClock();}}
    if(busy)cancelJobs();return true;
  }
  function afterMove(i,color){ensureTree();if(clock.enabled&&clock.running){clock=C.clockAction(clock,'move',Date.now(),3-color);if(S.result)clock=C.clockAction(clock,'pause',Date.now());scheduleClock();}
    if(training){training.step++;if(training.step>=training.sequence.length||S.result){training.done=true;const grade=training.assisted?1:training.misses?2:3;academy.reviews[training.id]=C.reviewSchedule(academy.reviews[training.id],grade,Date.now());academy.achievements['first-vcf']=Date.now();academySave();if(forcingSeries&&!training.seriesRecorded){training.seriesRecorded=true;forcingSeries.results.push({id:training.id,misses:training.misses,assisted:training.assisted});}$('proofTrainingText').textContent='Verified line completed. '+(training.assisted?'Assisted practice.':'Your repetition has been recorded.');}
      else if(currentColor()!==training.color){const id=training.id,point=training.sequence[training.step];clearTimeout(autoDefense);autoDefense=setTimeout(()=>{autoDefense=0;if(training?.id===id&&!training.done&&!S.reviewing&&!S.editing&&currentColor()!==training.color)commit(point,'training');},380);}}
    if(S.result)recordResult();}
  function renderPlus(){experienceRender?.();learningRender?.();document.body.dataset.tab=S.tab;if($('repertoireCard'))$('repertoireCard').hidden=!repertoireSession||repertoireSession.gameId!==S.gameId;if(markerMode!=='off'&&(S.mode==='study'||S.reviewing))for(const b of pointButtons)b.setAttribute('aria-disabled','false');ensureTree();renderDeep();if(S.tab==='study'){renderTree();renderReviewTable();selection();}drawGraph();
    if(document.activeElement!==$('gameFolder'))$('gameFolder').value=folder;if(document.activeElement!==$('gameTags'))$('gameTags').value=tags;

    if(match&&S.mode==='local'){$('blackName').textContent=S.humanColor===1?'Player A':'Player B';$('whiteName').textContent=S.humanColor===2?'Player A':'Player B';}if(openingRecord&&S.mode==='local'){$('blackName').textContent='Player '+openingRecord.owners[1];$('whiteName').textContent='Player '+openingRecord.owners[2];}if(clock.enabled)tickClock();else $('clockStrip').hidden=true;
    if(network){for(const id of ['undoBtn','redoBtn','hintBtn','analyzeBtn','editBtn','passBtn','rematchBtn','reviewBtn','takeoverBtn','deepAnalyzeBtn','vcfBtn','vctBtn','reviewAllBtn','newVariationBtn'])$(id).disabled=true;$('resignBtn').disabled=!!S.result||network.role==='spectator';$('onlineBtn').textContent='Room '+network.id;$('statusText').textContent=(network.state?.players?.length<2?'Waiting for opponent':S.result?'Room finished':currentColor()===network.color?'Your move':'Opponent’s move')+' · '+network.id;if(network.state?.openingInfo)$('statusText').textContent=network.state.openingInfo.label+' · '+network.id;renderNetworkClock();renderNetworkOpening();}
  }

  // Built-in invite-only private-room client. The server is authoritative for turns and move legality.
  const ROOM_API_BASE='https://hycegznamzjhwinegaai.supabase.co/functions/v1/gomoku-room';
  const ROOM_API_KEY='sb_publishable_1rZzRPzfLMaAH5pIgCwIjA_19UPMIsR';
  let pollTimer=0,roomRequest=false;
  function endpoint(){return (network?.base||'').replace(/\/$/,'');}
  async function roomFetch(path,body){const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),9000);try{const res=await fetch(endpoint()+path,{method:body?'POST':'GET',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':ROOM_API_KEY,...(network?.token?{'Authorization':'Bearer '+network.token}:{})},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined,signal:controller.signal,cache:'no-store'});let data;try{data=await res.json();}catch{throw Object.assign(Error('Private-room server returned an invalid response.'),{status:res.status});}if(!res.ok)throw Object.assign(Error(data.error||'Room request failed.'),{status:res.status});return data;}finally{clearTimeout(timer);}}
  function rememberRoom(){try{sessionStorage.setItem('gomoku.room.v4',JSON.stringify(network));}catch{}}
  function applyRoomState(state){if(!network||state.id!==network.id||state.revision<network.revision)return;network.revision=state.revision;network.color=state.you?.color||0;network.role=state.you?.role||'spectator';network.state=state;network.receivedAt=performance.now();
    const changed=JSON.stringify(S.records.map(m=>({i:m.i,color:m.color})))!==JSON.stringify(state.game.moves)||(S.result?.winner??null)!==(state.game.result?.winner??null)||(S.result?.reason??null)!==(state.game.result?.reason??null);
    if(changed||S.gameId!=='room-'+state.id+'-'+state.round){const keepRoomDialog=$('workbenchDialog').open&&!!$('roomDetails');const data={...blankGame({mode:'local',variant:state.rule}),gameId:'room-'+state.id+'-'+state.round,moves:state.game.moves,terminal:state.game.terminal,imported:true,title:'Room '+state.id,studio:{...newExtra(),clock:C.createClock(0,0)}};applyData(data,{queue:false});setTab('play');if(keepRoomDialog)$('workbenchDialog').showModal();}rememberRoom();render();renderRoomDetails();renderNetworkOpening();renderNetworkClock();ensureRoomStream();}
  async function pollRoom(){clearTimeout(pollTimer);if(!network)return;const session=network;try{const state=await roomFetch('/api/rooms/'+session.id);if(network===session)applyRoomState(state);}catch(err){if(network){network.error=err.message;if($('roomStatus'))$('roomStatus').textContent='Disconnected: '+err.message+' Retrying; the server retains the game.';}}finally{if(network&&!roomStream)pollTimer=setTimeout(pollRoom,1200);}}
  async function sendRoom(body){if(!network||roomRequest)return;const session=network;roomRequest=true;const payload={...body,revision:session.revision,...(Number.isInteger(session.state?.gameVersion)?{gameVersion:session.state.gameVersion}:{}),commandId:typeof crypto?.randomUUID==='function'?crypto.randomUUID():uid()+'_'+Date.now()};try{let state;try{state=await roomFetch('/api/rooms/'+session.id+'/action',payload);}catch(error){if(network!==session||error.status&&error.status!==503)throw error;state=await roomFetch('/api/rooms/'+session.id+'/action',payload);}if(network===session)applyRoomState(state);}catch(err){safeError(err);if(network===session)await pollRoom();}finally{roomRequest=false;renderNetworkOpening();}}
  function leaveRoom(){const study=dataForTree(ensureTree());stopRoomStream();clearTimeout(pollTimer);network=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem('gomoku.room.v4');}catch{}$('onlineBtn').textContent='Online room';applyData(study,{queue:false});renderNetworkOpening();$('clockToggle').disabled=false;toast('Disconnected from the room. function showProof(cert){if(!C.verifyCertificate(cert))throw Error('Certificate failed independent verification.');openDesk('Verified strategy · proof tree','<p class="proof-status proven" id="certificateStatus"></p><p class="muted">An upper bound covers every legal defense represented by this certificate. This is not a shortest-win claim.</p><div class="proof-tree" id="certificateTree"></div>');$('certificateStatus').textContent=cert.kind.toUpperCase()+' · '+name(cert.attacker)+' wins within '+cert.upperBoundPlies+' plies · '+D.rules[cert.rule].label;let shown=0;
 function branch(n,parent,label='Attack'){if(++shown>600){parent.append(text('p','Display limit reached. Export preserves the complete proof.','tiny'));return;}const box=document.createElement('details');box.className='proof-node';const sum=text('summary',label+': '+coord(n.move)+' · '+n.type+' · ≤'+n.plies+' plies');box.append(sum);const inside=document.createElement('div');box.append(inside);let built=false;box.addEventListener('toggle',()=>{if(!box.open||built)return;built=true;if(n.ends)inside.append(text('p','Winning endpoints: '+n.ends.map(coord).join(', '),'tiny'));if(!n.replies?.length)inside.append(text('p','Terminal structure verified by the rules kernel.','tiny'));for(const r of n.replies||[])branch(r.proof,inside,'After defense '+coord(r.move));});parent.append(box);}

async function runEngineCheck(){if(busy||network)return;cancelJobs();const epoch=activeJobSeries;busy=true;S.hintBusy=true;render();openDesk('Engine check','<p class="muted">Twelve tactical teaching fixtures at 120 ms each, including the V8.6 safety and candidate layer. This is a smoke check, not an Elo or professional-strength benchmark. The package also includes a 1,676-fixture reproducible corpus.</p><p id="engineCheckStatus" role="status">Starting…</p><div id="engineCheckRows"></div><button class="btn ghost" id="exportEngineCheck" disabled>Export measured results</button>');const report={version:6,engine:'6.0-hybrid',at:new Date().toISOString(),userAgent:navigator.userAgent,fixtures:[],budget:120};
 try{const set=pack.drills.filter((_,i)=>i%37===0).slice(0,12);for(const p of set){if(epoch!==activeJobSeries||!$('engineCheckRows'))break;const e=createEngine(p.rule),b=e.validateSetup(p.initial,p.turn),r=await runJob('choose',{board:Array.from(b),color:p.turn,rule:p.rule,options:{timeMs:120,maxDepth:6,width:14,requireWasm:true}});if(epoch!==activeJobSeries||!$('engineCheckRows'))break;const legal=e.classify(b,r.move,p.turn).legal,solved=D.solvesPuzzle(e,b,p.turn,r.move,p.goal);report.fixtures.push({id:p.id,rule:p.rule,legal,solved,backend:r.backend,depth:r.depth,ms:r.elapsedMs,nodes:r.nodes});$('engineCheckRows').append(text('p',p.theme+' · '+(solved?'objective met':legal?'legal, objective missed':'ILLEGAL')+' · '+r.backend+' · '+r.elapsedMs+' ms','tiny'));$('engineCheckStatus').textContent=report.fixtures.length+' / '+set.length+' fixtures checked.';}
 if($('exportEngineCheck')){$('exportEngineCheck').disabled=false;$('exportEngineCheck').onclick=()=>download(new Blob([JSON.stringify(report,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),'gomoku-engine-check.json');}return report;}catch(e){safeError(e);}finally{if(epoch===activeJobSeries){busy=false;S.hintBusy=false;render();}}}
